chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'vintage industrial 12 drawer steel cabinet', 'multi drawer metal parts cabinet industrial', 'Namco 12 drawer cabinet', 'steel index card cabinet 10 drawer', 'Namco filing chest'. Also Gumtree/Facebook Marketplace Tasmania asking prices for 'industrial drawer cabinet' for local resale ceiling. Check postage/pickup, as freight on a bulky steel cabinet limits eBay sales.
viewing_check: Read the maker badge on top front (Namco or other), measure width and depth, check every drawer runs and has no missing runners or dividers, extent of rust through the base and lower drawer, and whether the top is solid or rotted.
